scope: one-layer actual-weight operation-complete research leaf; no runtime route or model-wide sidecar

external_reference.usage: read-only builtin ABI and served-layout reference; candidate device implementation is original in-tree code

gate_quantization.source: dequantized authoritative Q4_K_S tensor (not original BF16/F16)

up_quantization.source: dequantized authoritative Q4_K_S tensor (not original BF16/F16)

protocol.cold_pool: actual gate/up source pair and both execution views exceed 64 MiB
protocol.activations: deterministic BF16-rounded N(0, 0.2) synthetic rows; actual layer-0 weights

gates.quality_note: Gate/up channel top-1 and softmax KL are localization diagnostics, not the project's full-vocabulary outer gate. The re-quantized Q4_K_S S4 view is T3 and remains unqualified without the complete model gate.

profiler.command: HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/hipengine-hipcc-version.txt PYTHONPATH=. rocprofv3 --kernel-trace --output-format csv -d /tmp/mtp-iu4-r2-rocprof -- python3 scripts/qwen38_iu4_s4_gate_up_leaf.py --model /models/gguf/Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_S.gguf --layer 0 --rows 2,3,4,5,8,16,32,64,96,128 --warmups 0 --samples 1 --burst 1 --dequant-chunk-rows 128 --compiler-version-file /tmp/hipengine-hipcc-version.txt --require-cached-build --output /tmp/mtp-iu4-r2-rocprof-result.json

focused_gpu_cpu_registry.command: HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/hipengine-hipcc-version.txt python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_iu4_s4_sidecar.py tests/test_mtp_iu4_roofline.py tests/test_model_quant_and_imports.py tests/test_gfx1151_backend.py

validation.model_quality_gate_skipped_reason: T3 candidate failed native B1-B3 inclusive speed gate and has no runtime route; full model promotion is not attempted.
